title: Which squares ending in one come after twenty nine squared?
description: The video finds the next two squares that end in one, using the fact that the number must end in one or nine, and shows how to spot numbers that cannot be squares. Keeko doubts the next two numbers after skipping those that end in nine.
teaching_notes: One idea: a square ends in one when the number ends in one or in nine, and no square ends in two, three, seven or eight. Watch for students who list only the numbers ending in one.

source: Write the next two squares ending in 1 after 29², and five numbers that cannot be squares.
video_script.why: The child uses the last digit to find squares ending in one and to spot numbers that can never be squares.
video_script.substitution: List the numbers ending in one or nine after twenty nine, square them, and read the last digits that no square can have.
video_script.anchor: the list of squares ending in one from the book, with the next two places empty
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko takes only the numbers ending in one, so picks thirty one and forty one. Nine times nine is eighty one, so numbers ending in nine count too, and thirty nine comes before forty one.
video_script.payoff_line: The next two squares are nine hundred sixty one and one thousand five hundred twenty one

final_answer.value: 961 and 1521; for example 52, 73, 107, 218 and 1003 are not squares
final_answer.spoken: nine hundred sixty one and one thousand five hundred twenty one

never_show: a number ending in 2, 3, 7 or 8 other than the ones the video uses
maths_rules: a number ending in 1 or 9 has a square ending in 1: 1 × 1 = 1 and 9 × 9 = 81
after 29 the next numbers ending in 1 or 9 are 31 and 39
squares end only in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 or 9, so numbers ending in 2, 3, 7 or 8 are not squares: 52, 73, 107, 218, 1003
check: 7² = 49 and 8² = 64, and 52 lies between them, so 52 is not a square
the slip: 31 and 41 skips 39, and 39² = 1521 comes before 41² = 1681

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step one, the number must end in one or nine.
<bookmark mark='next'/>After twenty nine, the next such numbers are thirty one and thirty nine.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Step two, square them. Thirty one times thirty one is nine hundred sixty one.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Thirty nine times thirty nine is one thousand five hundred twenty one.
